title: Conditioning as the Primitive Relational Process
purpose: Promote conditioning from an arithmetic interpretation to a primitive relational mechanism that generates admissible multiplicity.

core_shift.from: Multiplication is the primitive interpretation of juxtaposition.
core_shift.to: Conditioning is the primitive interpretation of juxtaposition.

summary.thesis: Within these models, RT mechanics is not treated as an arithmetic system. Arithmetic is one admissible projection of deeper relational conditioning.

primitive_axiom.statement: Every admissible distinction exists only under conditioning.

conditioned_distinction.meaning: Distinction a conditioned by context b.

legacy_notation.status: Deprecated as primary notation because it carries arithmetic assumptions.

conditioning.definition: Conditioning is the primitive relational process by which one distinction provides the admissibility context for another.

multiplicity.definition: Multiplicity is generated through conditioning rather than arithmetic combination.

ordering.principle: Relational ordering is part of the mathematical object.
ordering.observation: Different conditioning orders produce different relational objects even when the symbolic distinctions are identical.

interpretation_rules.rule: No distinction is interpreted independently of conditioning.
Conditioning is asymmetric unless explicitly declared symmetric.
Arithmetic operations are admissible projections, not primitive mechanics.

future_promotions.goal: Define RT as recursive conditioning of conditioned distinctions.
Formalize admissibility flow through conditioned relations.
Derive arithmetic, geometry, probability, and logic as projections of conditioning mechanics.

validation_questions: What invariants are preserved under conditioning?
When do two conditioned distinctions become equivalent?
Can admissibility be measured independently of arithmetic?
How does conditioning induce relational propagation?

design_intent.goal: Replace primitive arithmetic operators with primitive relational conditioning while allowing arithmetic to emerge as a derived projection.
design_intent.long_term_direction: A relational mechanics in which conditioning, admissibility, and propagation replace quantity, operation, and evaluation as the foundational concepts.

governance_notes: This induction is provisional and definitional. It does not by itself replace existing operator registry entries or promote arithmetic displacement claims outside the current governed stack.

The examples in the ordering section are interpretive projections used to distinguish conditioning order from arithmetic reading. They are not proofs that all arithmetic is recoverable from conditioning.
Future promotion requires explicit composition rules, invariants, equivalence conditions, and propagation constraints under declared admissibility context.
